parameters: Lord Terenor is being attacked at Fort Eureeka. Why does he not simply withdraw?! We are forced to break the siege coming from the west.\! You, soldier, to me! What is your name?
Here, Captain! Barnabas Fitch, of Melmonde, sir!

I noticed the way you handled yourself at Armitage. Well done, soldier.\! Melmonde? It seems your home town may soon be on the front lines of battle.\! Do you think you can lead a heavy cavalry detachment? Speed is of the essence in this mission and we will need young men like you most of all.
Y-yes sir, I mean...\| I'll do what I can, Captain!\! Ain't much different than wranglin' wild horses back at the family farm, right?!
Be sure not to let your men hear such a metaphor, kid.\! Lessons later, we need to move to Fort Eureeka. On the double!

The age of Veridia will soon come to an end!\! Men of Ezrum, go, and bring glory to Sayunaa in my name!\! And we shall reduce Stormrook to rubble - these arrogant Midlander pigs must be sent a message. They will fear the utterance of the name, Rostam, Duke of Ezrum, ruler of Veridia!
By Donar... Sayunaa has decided to move. We were told they would remain neutral!
Where I come from, a man 'n his word are all he's got! What gives?!

We've seen the death of honor for some time now, soldier. Truth be told, this should be a surprise to no one.\! We must now protect both Fort Eureeka and Stormrook as well.\! May these treacherous Sayunaari not hold one parcel of Veridian ground!\! The walls of Stormrook have not fallen in a thousand years. Today shall be no different.
